question: When can equipped Noros grant self ATK after Skill admission, and how do its10-second buff and20-second trigger cooldown interact?
decision: Use successful native Redirect Skill admission as trigger, self base-ATK percentage for10seconds, one nonstacking buff before same-time hits, and per-wearer20-second world-time cooldown. A cast inside cooldown does not refresh the buff. Switching preserves cooldown and the earned buff. This order/clock rule is a tested model hypothesis; release availability remains unverified.
stop_condition: Bind T1-T5 curves/units, validate trigger/buff/ICD boundaries and failed admission, off-field ownership, legal Jiuyuan build and CLI/WASM/Worker parity.
return_condition: New source order, ATK scaling, clock, cooldown or release evidence conflicts with the model.

Recasts inside cooldown do not refresh; a Skill one microsecond before20,000,100us gives no grant, while exact readiness does. Normal/Ultimate input cannot trigger even with E packet classification. Wrong equipment, duplicate proc and zero cooldown fail; failed admission grants nothing.

Delayed wearer hits retain self buff off-field and sample exact expiry at delivery; the active ally is unchanged. Exit/reentry preserves trigger cooldown, so13seconds remains unbuffed and20seconds grants again.
